name: gizza-ai/smart-quotes-clean
summary: Replace smart quotes and typographic characters with ASCII.

tool.description: Replace smart (curly) quotes, em/en dashes, the ellipsis glyph, prime marks, guillemets, and other typographic characters with plain ASCII equivalents: “ ” -> ", ‘ ’ -> ', – (en dash) -> -, — (em dash) -> -- (configurable via em_dash), … -> ..., ′ ″ -> ' ". Set em_dash to '-' or ' - ' to change how em dashes render. With normalize_spaces=true (default) it also folds non-breaking/thin/ideographic spaces to a regular space and strips zero-width characters and the BOM. Ordinary Unicode — accents, CJK, emoji — is preserved.

text.description: The text to clean of smart quotes and other typographic characters.

em_dash.description: ASCII rendering for em dashes (—) and horizontal bars (―): '--' (default), '-', or ' - ' (a spaced hyphen).

normalize_spaces.description: When true (default), exotic Unicode spaces (non-breaking, thin, ideographic, …) become a regular space and zero-width characters (incl. the BOM) are removed; set false to leave whitespace untouched.
